blocks.html: Rock and soil anchors discussed in this document are cement grouted, prestressed tendons (bars or strands) that are installed in soil or rock. Permanent prestressed rock and soil anchors shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Sections 1815.2 through 1815.8 and PTI DC35.1.
